text:
Maria (CS): heads up 1 - Northridge Analytics WAU fell ~60% over 3 weeks. renewal due in 45d. their product lead (Aisha) left last week; current contact is a contractor. flagging renewal risk.
Juan (AM): when did Aisha leave? did they provide a handoff doc?
Maria (CS): they sent one short email Friday, no real handover. contractor is more tactical and doesn't appear to own roadmap.
RenewalBot: account_health_score: 47 (was 82 two months ago). last_active_seat: 2026-02-18. primary_endpoints: embedding-create, chat-stream.
Priya (SE): can we get call logs + representative prompts? want to see whether entire org dropped or just the champion. i'll analyze for drift patterns.
Maria (CS): quick skim of logs: org-level calls down across most human users. embeddings stable from a single bot user.
Zac (Platform): running quick seats query:
```
SELECT week, count(distinct user_id) as active_seats
FROM events
WHERE account_id = 'northridge'
GROUP BY week
ORDER BY week DESC
LIMIT 6;
```
Zac (Platform): results (newest->oldest): 2, 3, 5, 6, 8, 8. Steady decline.
Juan (AM): timeline is tight. suggested salvage options: 1) short dedicated trial to show perf wins, 2) joint QBR + health audit to re-engage stakeholders, or 3) procurement pricing incentive.
Maria (CS): priority A: re-establish a champion. i can ask for a 15m intro with interim PM to understand use cases. priority B: quick usage stim 1 - offer a 30k-token demo burst for internal demos.
Priya (SE): technical blocker: contractor may not have permissions to run demos. propose we provision a temporary demo account pre-seeded with example prompts and dashboards. i'll own the kit and a 2-min walkthrough video.
Juan (AM): will loop Legal for a limited-time offer; need template language for trial. also heard procurement is running a bake-off with FlashServe. they asked for perf numbers last week.
Maria (CS): do we have benchmark exports comparing our embeddings latency vs FlashServe?
Zac (Platform): we have a perf snapshot for our dedicated stack. ill produce a one-pager with p50/p95 latencies and cost-per-embedding and include quantization/bsz notes. aiming EOD.
RenewalBot: ticket created: "CS-8243: Northridge renewal-risk 1 champion left, competitive bake-off". assigned: Maria, Juan.
Maria (CS): next steps: - Juan: confirm procurement timeline + bake-off owner. - Zac: perf one-pager + infra caveats. - Priya: demo kit + quickstart for interim PM. - Maria: schedule 15m intro with interim PM and request stakeholder list.
Juan (AM): pinging @ProcurementOps now to ask who runs the bake-off and whether there's a formal rubric.
Priya (SE): creating demo repo with: preloaded notebook, sample prompts, 2-min demo video, and a troubleshooting checklist.
Zac (Platform): note on perf messaging: surface our fallback/rollout guarantees and config (batching, KV cache) if they ask about reliability vs FlashServe.
Maria (CS): if we can lock a 15m touch with the interim PM within 72h we might recover demo momentum. also request a two-week trial window if procurement allows.
Juan (AM): quick update: procurement replied 1 bake-off begins in 9 days, scorecard focuses on latency, throughput, and integration effort. they'll accept a 2-week trial.
Maria (CS): great. i'll prioritize the intro and request the trial contract.
Zac (Platform): perf one-pager uploaded: https://redwood.internal/share/northridge-perf-171900. includes p95, batch sizing used, and cost estimates.
Priya (SE): demo kit ready in 24h. i'll share repo link in this thread.
Maria (CS): assigning high renewal flag until first call. treat as active salvage sprint. calendar invite to interim PM once procurement confirms availability. :eyes:
RenewalBot: reminder set for 72h: "Northridge outreach follow-up".
Maria (CS): closing notes: small tactical sprint, immediate focus on re-championing + perf proof for bake-off. i'll update after the intro call. :white_check_mark:
